name: mirage
text: Got it. Nothing needs pausing, so no money is needed for either part. The bets-vanishing check needs no betting. The fix is already on GitHub's list, and a few minutes of sampling show it holding steady at 29 rows with no empty gaps. If you still see vanishing, the logs will say why. The 'no one was selling' log fills only when a bet is tried. Whenever you add money and try bets, the report saves to GitHub by itself and I'll read it. Until then it just waits.
